item.description: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies has been hailed as a hero ⁠for running out of ⁠his store to detain a man who ⁠authorities allege deliberately drove a car into lawmaker Helen Haines in the small town of Wangaratta, an incident that has shocked the country. Jefferies had just finished haircuts for a young family on Monday when he said he heard a “loud bang” outside his shop and realised the ‌driver of a Toyota LandCruiser had struck Haines, leaving her badly injured. “It was crazy, I just ran... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: NZ's climate in 'uncharted territory,' with more extreme weather events ahead
item.description: Much is being made of a record-strength El Niño event that could well spell a drier, windier summer for the north and east of New Zealand. But, as a major new assessment shows, it is forming against a backdrop of warming that's pushed the country's climate into "uncharted territory." Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: The mother of Complainant A has told a trial she "trusted" Alan Jones as a mentor to her young son before the veteran broadcaster allegedly indecently assaulted the 17-year-old schoolboy. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tracing Brendan Nugent's online presence
item.description: ABC NEWS Verify has uncovered clues online as to the history of the man in police custody over the alleged attack on Helen Haines. His posting history reveals little evidence of malice towards the MP. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australian lawmaker hurt in car attack loses leg: media
item.description: Australian lawmaker Helen Haines has lost a leg after being struck by a car in a deliberate attack, local media said Tuesday. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Kenyan death cult leader found guilty of 191 murder charges
item.description: A Kenyan court on Monday found starvation cult leader ⁠Paul Mackenzie and about 30 others guilty of ⁠murder over the deaths of 190 children and one adult in ⁠one of the world’s worst cult-related disasters in recent history. Mackenzie and his co-accused will be given their sentence on November 6. Mackenzie was arrested in 2023 after police received a tip-off, and weeks later authorities began uncovering bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola Forest near the coast in southeastern... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
